title: Senior Product Manager, Content Management
jd_excerpt:
ABOUT THE ROLE
 VTEX is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the future of Content Management across our Commerce Platform.
 This role is for product builders. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just write specs and manage roadmaps, but someone who actively uses modern AI tools, rapid prototyping techniques, and emerging technologies to accelerate discovery, validation, and execution.
 As the Product Manager for CMS, you will shape how brands, marketers, developers, and AI systems create, manage, and deliver digital experiences on VTEX. You will be responsible for defining the next generation of content management capabilities, helping customers move faster from idea to production while maintaining the flexibility and performance required by enterprise commerce. You will work at the intersection of commerce, content, AI, developer experience, and user experience. 
 Success in this role requires strong product judgment, technical curiosity, and a passion for building. We expect you to be comfortable turning ideas into working prototypes, leveraging tools like Claude Code, Spec Kit, AI coding assistants, agents, MCP-based workflows, and other emerging technologies to validate solutions.
 This is a role for someone who believes the future of product management is increasingly hands-on and AI-native.
 ABOUT THE TEAM
 The CMS team owns the systems that power content creation, collaboration, and delivery across storefronts. Our mission is to enable merchants to create rich, performant, and personalized digital experiences with speed and confidence.
 We build the experience that powers everything from landing pages and merchandising experiences to personalized content journeys and AI-assisted content operations. As commerce becomes increasingly AI-driven, the CMS team is at the forefront of defining how content, data, agents, and commerce workflows come together.
 Our team consists of product managers, engineers, and designers who care deeply about craft, experimentation, and customer impact. We value builders who are excited to challenge assumptions, prototype new ideas quickly, and leverage technology to create meaningful advantages for our customers.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for VTEX CMS.
 Identify opportunities where AI can fundamentally improve content creation, management, personalization, governance, and delivery.
 Work closely with engineering and design to build best-in-class content management experiences for enterprise commerce.
 Rapidly validate ideas through prototypes, proofs of concept, and experimentation.
 Leverage modern AI development workflows and tools to accelerate product discovery, specification, and validation.
 Partner with customers to deeply understand content operations, publishing workflows, developer needs, and business challenges.
 Drive product decisions through a combination of customer insights, market research, experimentation, and data analysis.
 Collaborate with platform teams to ensure CMS capabilities integrate seamlessly with storefront, search, merchandising, and commerce services.
 Stay at the forefront of AI, developer tooling, content management, and digital experience trends, identifying opportunities that create durable competitive advantages.
 Define clear success metrics and continuously measure product impact, adoption, and customer outcomes.
 Influence product direction across multiple teams and contribute to VTEX’s broader platform strategy.
 WHO YOU ARE
 Builder First
 You are passionate about building products and turning ideas into reality.
 You regularly use AI tools to accelerate your work and are excited about the future of AI-native product development.
 You are comfortable creating prototypes, workflows, mock implementations, or technical proofs of concept yourself.
 You believe that reducing the distance between an idea and customer validation is a competitive advantage.
 Strong Product Thinker
 You have experience leading product strategy and execution for complex software products.
 You can balance long-term vision with pragmatic decision-making and fast iteration.
 You understand how to identify customer problems worth solving and translate them into successful products.
 AI-Native Mindset
 You have strong knowledge of modern AI technologies and concepts, including large language models, agents, tool calling, MCPs (Model Context Protocol), retrieval systems, AI workflows, and emerging development paradigms.
 You understand both the opportunities and limitations of AI systems and can apply them thoughtfully to real customer problems.
 You actively experiment with new tools and techniques to improve product outcomes.
 Technically Curious
 You are comfortable discussing technical architecture, APIs, integrations, developer workflows, and platform capabilities.
 You can effectively collaborate with engineers and make informed product tradeoffs.
 Previous experience with developer platforms, content management systems, AI products, or enterprise SaaS is a strong plus.
 Customer Obsessed
 You have a deep curiosity about how users work and what drives successful outcomes.
 You seek direct customer feedback and use it to inform product decisions.
 You care about solving real problems rather than simply shipping features.
 Exceptional Communicator
 You can clearly articulate product strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs across technical and non-technical audiences.
 You build alignment across engineering, design, and leadership stakeholders.

 HOW WE BUILD PRODUCT AT VTEX 
 At VTEX, the PM role has already been reinvented. This isn't a vision — it's how we work today. 
PMs don't write specs for others to interpret. They bring the Vision and a product Brief . An AI agent — equipped with VTEX skills, tools, and an automatically provisioned testing environment — proposes the spec and builds a functional prototype. The PM tests it. We are operating with unprecedented speed.
 If you want to build at the frontier of the product profession — at unprecedented speed, with AI as your co-builder — this is the place. 
 About VTEX
 VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the backbone for connected commerce that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. VTEX’s platform is designed to be the AI-native operating system for the commerce ecosystem, enabling enterprise brands and retailers to orchestrate their complex network of consumers, business partners, suppliers, and fulfillment providers in one place. VTEX puts its customers’ business on a fast path to growth with a complete Commerce, Marketplace, and OMS solution. VTEX helps global companies build, manage and deliver native and advanced B2B, B2C, and Marketplace commerce experiences, as well as Retail Media solutions, with competitive time-to-market and without complexity, so they can stay relevant for the modern, convenience-driven consumer. Trusted by 2,200 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, VTEX supports 3,100 active online stores across 44 countries (FY ended December 31, 2025).
 BENEFITS 
 Annual profit-sharing program and equity eligibility;
 Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX;
 Annual budget for professional development in Tech;
 Language development incentive program (English, Spanish, Portuguese);
 Flexible meal allowance;
 Extended parental leaves;
 Child-care assistance;
 Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture;
 Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup;
 Wellness program;
 Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores
